The Multi-Skilled Engineering Technician is responsible for the day-to-day maintenance, repair and upkeep of hotel guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house facilities and engineering equipment. The role ensures that all electrical, plumbing, HVAC, mechanical and general maintenance issues are resolved safely and promptly, with minimum disruption to guests and hotel operations.
q: ITI, Diploma or technical certification in Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Plumbing or a related engineering discipline.
Approximately 2–4 years of hands-on maintenance experience, preferably within a hotel, resort, serviced apartment or similar hospitality environment.
Practical competency in at least two maintenance disciplines with working knowledge of other hotel engineering functions.
Ability to troubleshoot common electrical, HVAC and plumbing faults.
Ability to use hand tools, power tools and basic testing instruments safely.
Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
r: Attend guest room maintenance requests promptly and professionally, ensuring minimum inconvenience to guests.
Inspect and repair room defects including lighting, power sockets, air-conditioning, plumbing fixtures, showers, toilets, drainage, doors, locks and basic furniture fittings.
Rectify maintenance issues in corridors, restaurants, meeting rooms, lobby areas, offices, kitchens and other hotel facilities.
Ensure rooms taken Out of Order (OOO) or Out of Service (OOS) for engineering reasons are repaired promptly and communicated for release back to operation.
Maintain high standards of appearance and functionality in guest-facing areas.
Carry out scheduled Preventive Planned Maintenance (PPM) for guest rooms, public areas and engineering equipment.

Perform first-line troubleshooting and repairs on: Electrical and lighting systems HVAC systems, including FCUs and AHUs Plumbing, drainage and sanitary systems Pumps, motors and valves Hot and cold-water systems Basic kitchen and laundry equipment Doors, locks and general building fabric
Record equipment readings and report abnormalities, unusual noise, leakage, overheating or deterioration.
Escalate major faults to the Engineering Supervisor or relevant specialist contractor.
Assist qualified specialists with major repairs and servicing where required.
Respond promptly to engineering requests raised by Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Security and other hotel departments.
Prioritize guest-related defects and operationally critical equipment.
Coordinate access to occupied guest rooms professionally and follow the hotel's guest-room entry procedures.
Maintain professional appearance, conduct and communication when working in guest areas.
Support hotel functions, events, room moves and emergency requirements when engineering assistance is required.
Follow approved hotel HSE, Permit-to-Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), electrical isolation and equipment safety procedures.
Use appropriate PPE and tools for each maintenance activity.
Immediately report unsafe conditions, equipment defects, leaks, fire hazards, incidents and near misses.
Maintain plant rooms, workshops and engineering areas in a clean, safe and organized condition.
Support required inspections and testing associated with hotel life-safety and engineering systems.
Follow applicable UAE safety requirements and hotel operating procedures.
Receive and close engineering work orders through the hotel's maintenance management system.
Record work completed, faults identified, materials used and any outstanding action required.
Maintain appropriate records of PPM activities and equipment inspections.
Inform the supervisor when spare parts or consumables need replenishment.
Provide a proper handover of outstanding faults and priority work to the next shift.
